cases.label: 활성 상한·슬롯 회수·입력 순서
cases.probe: const releases=[];const started=[];const startedSignals=Array.from({length:4},(_,i)=>new Promise(resolve=>{started[i]=resolve;}));const gates=Array.from({length:4},(_,index)=>new Promise(resolve=>{releases[index]=resolve;}));let active=0;let maximum=0;const starts=[];const tasks=gates.map((gate,index)=>()=>{starts.push(index);active++;maximum=Math.max(maximum,active);started[index]();return gate.then(value=>{active--;return value;});});const pending=Promise.resolve(submission.runBounded(tasks,{limit:2}));const ended=pending.then(()=>false,()=>false);await Promise.race([Promise.all(startedSignals.slice(0,2)),ended]);const initial=starts.slice();releases[1]('B');await Promise.race([startedSignals[2],ended]);const reused=starts.slice();releases[0]('A');releases[2]('C');releases[3]('D');observe({initial,reused,maximum,activeAfter:await pending.then(()=>active),results:await pending});

cases.label: throw와 rejection 후에도 다음 작업을 처리
시도 번호와 주입한 지수 backoff 기록
cases.probe: const attempts=[];const waits=[];const result=await submission.runBounded([({attempt,index})=>{attempts.push({attempt,index});if(attempt<3)throw new Error('retry');return 'ok';}],{limit:1,retries:2,baseDelay:3,wait:async(delay,context)=>{waits.push({delay,index:context.index,attempt:context.attempt});}});observe({attempts,waits,result});

cases.label: 재시도 상한 이후 마지막 오류 이유 보존
이미 취소된 입력에서는 작업을 시작하지 않는다
취소 뒤 대기열을 시작하지 않고 활성 완료를 정리
cases.probe: const controller=new AbortController();const releases=[];const started=[];const startedSignals=Array.from({length:2},(_,i)=>new Promise(resolve=>{started[i]=resolve;}));const gates=Array.from({length:4},(_,index)=>new Promise(resolve=>{releases[index]=resolve;}));const starts=[];const signals=[];const pending=Promise.resolve(submission.runBounded(gates.map((gate,index)=>context=>{starts.push(index);signals.push(context.signal===controller.signal);started[index]?.();return gate;}),{limit:2,signal:controller.signal}));await Promise.race([Promise.all(startedSignals),pending.then(()=>false,()=>false)]);controller.abort();releases.forEach((release,index)=>release(index));const result=await pending;observe({starts,signals,result});

cases.label: backoff 도중 취소되면 다음 시도를 시작하지 않는다
cases.probe: const controller=new AbortController();const calls=[];const waits=[];const result=await submission.runBounded([()=>{calls.push(0);throw new Error('retry');},()=>{calls.push(1);return 1;}],{limit:1,retries:3,signal:controller.signal,wait:async(delay,context)=>{waits.push({delay,same:context.signal===controller.signal});controller.abort();}});observe({calls,waits,result});

cases.label: wait 실패를 최종 실패로 기록하고 슬롯을 회수
cases.probe: const waitReason={code:'WAIT'};const calls=[];const result=await submission.runBounded([()=>{calls.push(0);throw new Error('task');},()=>{calls.push(1);return 'next';}],{limit:1,retries:3,wait:()=>Promise.reject(waitReason)});observe({calls,result:result?.map(item=>item.status==='rejected'?{status:item.status,attempts:item.attempts,same:item.reason===waitReason}:item)});

cases.label: 옵션과 작업 전체를 시작 전에 검증
cases.probe: let calls=0;const task=()=>{calls++;return 1;};const errors=[];for(const options of [{limit:0},{limit:1.5},{limit:33},{retries:-1},{retries:6},{retries:0.5},{baseDelay:-1},{baseDelay:Infinity},{baseDelay:'1'},{wait:null},null,[]]){try{await submission.runBounded([task],options);errors.push('accepted');}catch(error){errors.push(error.name);}}for(const tasks of [[task,null],null]){try{await submission.runBounded(tasks);errors.push('accepted');}catch(error){errors.push(error.name);}}observe({calls,errors});

cases.label: 재시도 대기 중에도 해당 작업의 슬롯을 유지
cases.probe: let release;const gate=new Promise(resolve=>{release=resolve;});let entered;const waiting=new Promise(resolve=>{entered=resolve;});const starts=[];const pending=Promise.resolve(submission.runBounded([({attempt})=>{starts.push('a:'+attempt);if(attempt===1)throw new Error('again');return 'A';},()=>{starts.push('b');return 'B';}],{limit:1,retries:1,wait:()=>{entered();return gate;}}));await Promise.race([waiting,pending.then(()=>false,()=>false)]);const beforeRelease=starts.slice();release();const result=await pending;observe({beforeRelease,starts,result});

cases.label: 빈 슬롯과 상속 요소는 실행 전에 거부
cases.probe: let calls=0;const task=()=>{calls++;return 1;};const sparse=[task,,task];const inherited=[task,,task];const prototype=Object.create(Array.prototype);prototype[1]=task;Object.setPrototypeOf(inherited,prototype);const errors=[];for(const tasks of [sparse,inherited]){try{await submission.runBounded(tasks);errors.push(false);}catch(error){errors.push(error instanceof TypeError);}}observe({calls,errors});

cases.label: 실제 AbortSignal만 허용하고 잘못된 신호에서는 시작 금지
cases.probe: let calls=0;const errors=[];for(const signal of [null,123,{}, {aborted:false}]){try{await submission.runBounded([()=>{calls++;return 1;}],{signal});errors.push(false);}catch(error){errors.push(error instanceof TypeError);}}observe({calls,errors});
